description: Reverse-ETL sink: mirror an upstream DataFrame into Recurly Account records. Recurly's PUT /accounts/{account_id} ONLY updates -- it 404s (never creates) if the account doesn't exist. This component checks existence first via GET /accounts/code-<value> (using lookup_field's value as the account code), then issues PUT (update) if found or POST /accounts (create) if not. Two API calls per row.

inputs.description: pandas DataFrame from an upstream asset. Each row -> one Recurly Account record (upserted via lookup_field as the account code).

outputs.description: Dagster asset materialization with metadata (rows_created / rows_updated / rows_errored / api_requests). No downstream data -- the write side effect lands in Recurly.

upstream_asset_key.label: Upstream Asset Key
upstream_asset_key.description: Asset providing the DataFrame. Mutually exclusive with `source`.

source.label: Inline Source
source.description: Inline source config (sql / csv / inline). Mutually exclusive with `upstream_asset_key`.

lookup_field.label: Lookup Field
lookup_field.description: Recurly Account field used as the merchant-assigned unique account code (substituted into the code-<value> path segment). MUST be present in fields_map values.

fields_map.label: Fields Map
fields_map.description: Upstream column -> Recurly Account field name.

batch_size.label: Batch Size
batch_size.description: Max upstream rows per run (safety cap). PUT only updates -- each row costs 1 existence-check GET + 1 write.

name: Recurly Account Upsert
